description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of the gold prefix and BLEU score for two different lines, representing "Inconsistency: wait-9" and an unnamed variable. The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale, ranges from 23 to 29, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line with circle markers starts at approximately 25 on the y-axis when the x-axis is 0, dips to around 23.5 at x=2, and then increases steadily to about 28.2 at x=20. The red solid line with square markers begins at around 25 on the y-axis when the x-axis is 0, peaks at approximately 26 at x=6, and then gradually decreases to about 25 at x=16 before rising to around 25.8 at x=20.
